changelog:
v1.25.2 - Musica discovery gate: the player must now LISTEN to their currently active musica for 1 minute before the level-up menu offers OTHER musicas and the HUD slot lets them switch to another one. New `Player.music_listening_time` accumulates in `_physics_process` (paused with the game), resets only when the active musica GROUP changes (not on a same-musica level-up), and drives `can_discover_other_music()` / `music_discovery_fraction()`. `_level_up()` skips any non-active musica card while the window hasn't elapsed (the active musica's own upgrade is always offered; the first musica is free). The HUD musica slot (index 3) now hosts a `CooldownOverlay` radial "listening clock" that counts down the minute and glows green when switching/discovery unlock, and the music-slot switch popup disables other musicas until then. New headless `test_musica_gate` suite added to CI; clean import + all 9 suites pass.
v1.25.1 - Rename newly added music assets to loop suffix convention and fully configure distinct track names for all levels across all six music categories in items_config.json.
v1.25.0 - Implement three new enemies (consulente, modella, bambino_fastidioso): configure enemy statistics, animations, and weapons; integrate into waves; implement dynamic shoot heights in WeaponSystem; support arcing banknote physics/thin rendering; implement in_love and bribed status effects + HUD icons; spawn bambino in clusters; and script custom AI behaviors (spiral circling, zig-zagging, and stop-to-attack windups).
